name: ReSkin research sensor (20 x 20 mm board)

sources.title: R. Bhirangi, T. Hellebrekers, C. Majidi and A. Gupta, "ReSkin: versatile, replaceable, lasting tactile skins", CoRL 2021, arXiv:2111.00071
sources.covers: sensing principle, sensing area 20 mm x 20 mm with 5 MLX90393 magnetometers 7 mm apart, thickness 2-3 mm, data rate ~400 Hz, data path (JST-SH to a Trinket M0 microcontroller), contact localisation and force results

note: A contact sensor, modelled by pad coverage, not a workspace camera, so it has no imagers. A research magnetic skin (open source, reskin.dev): a magnetised elastomer over a flexible board. Figures from the paper: "For an overall sensing area of 20mm x 20mm ... we measure magnetic flux changes using 5 magnetometers" (MLX90393, four spaced 7 mm apart around a central one); "compact (2-3mm thick)"; 20 values (temperature and Bx, By, Bz for 5 chips) sent over a JST-SH connector to a microcontroller (Adafruit Trinket M0) "at approximately 400 Hz" (entered as fps). taxels is null (5 magnetometers, not a taxel grid). Not stated: power, mass, size (beyond the sensing area and the thickness range). Its readings are not an image stream, so no stream is entered; the bandwidth budget needs the data rate as a measured or stated figure.
interface: JST-SH to a microcontroller (Adafruit Trinket M0), USB to the host
